title: Bad numbers
direction: Adult American man, thin slightly nasal voice, quick precise speech. Trying to stay professional while frightened. Rush the opening explanation, catch your breath before 'Everybody', lower your voice for the final realization. No added stuttering words.
text: I checked the books three times. The money didn't disappear. Somebody moved it into our account. Our account! Do you understand? Everybody who got robbed is about to think we're the clever ones. I have never wanted to look stupid so badly in my life.
